item.title: Frontier Exploration - Deadline-Driven Knowledge
item.description: Frontier Exploration: Deadline-Driven Knowledge Knowledge tied to specific dates, deadlines, or time windows that becomes incomplete, outdated, or harmful after expiration.

item.title: Frontier Exploration - Emergency and Crisis Knowledge
item.description: Frontier Exploration - Emergency and Crisis Knowledge Knowledge needed urgently under stress has fundamentally different requirements than regular procedural content.

item.title: Frontier Exploration - Ingredient Substitution Knowledge
item.description: Frontier Exploration: Ingredient Substitution Knowledge The Gap The Seed handles conditional/troubleshooting knowledge with if-then branches and user situational constraints (time, budget, equipment).

item.title: Frontier Exploration - Iterative Creative Knowledge
item.description: Frontier Exploration - Iterative Creative Knowledge Knowledge that involves cyclic evaluation and decision-making, not just linear sequences.

item.title: Frontier Exploration - Troubleshooting and Diagnostic Knowledge
item.description: Frontier Exploration - Troubleshooting and Diagnostic Knowledge Procedural knowledge tells you “how to do X.” Troubleshooting knowledge tells you “what’s wrong when X doesn’t work.” These are fundamentally different knowledge types with different structural needs.

item.title: Frontier Gap - Assembly and Kit-Based Knowledge
item.description: Frontier Gap: Assembly and Kit-Based Knowledge Knowledge about building, assembling, or constructing things from parts has unique characteristics that current Seed rules don’t explicitly address.

item.title: Seed Stress Test - Craft Knowledge Bases
item.description: Seed Stress Test: Craft Knowledge Bases Testing Seed rules against craft domains — cooking and brewing — which combine procedural knowledge, scientific principles, and sensory evaluation.
